style: Original cozy tech-office chunky game pixel art matching worker reference density and warm selective dark outlines. Orthographic top-down 3/4 view: visible top surfaces, vertical sides, NO isometric diagonal diamond projection. Aim 1 logical pixel per block at native 64x64. At most 3 shades per material, no gradient, noise, dithering or antialiasing. Furniture is simple wood, warm ivory, charcoal and teal. The worker image is STYLE AND PIXEL DENSITY REFERENCE ONLY; draw no people.

desk.action: Three identical wooden office desks with one dark monitor and keyboard each. Desk approx 56x38 logical pixels, flat top surface, legs beneath, facing viewer with monitor back edge high. Frame 0 monitor OFF black; frame 1 ON simple teal terminal blocks; frame 2 typing screen brighter cyan blocks. Desk geometry MUST remain identical; change only screen pixels. No chair, person, floor or shadow.

chair.action: One comfy dark teal office chair facing UP, backrest low at front so a worker drawn over it can type at desk above. Rounded square seat, little dark legs. About 28x32 logical pixels. No person or floor.

coffee_machine.action: One warm cream and charcoal coffee machine on a compact walnut cabinet. Copper accent, tiny teal ready light, cream cup physically placed under spout. About 30x40 logical pixels, no text or steam.

water_cooler.action: One compact cream water cooler with large pale blue water jug above it, teal dispenser and two simple taps. About 24x44 logical pixels. Opaque blue glass with only 2 shades, no transparency effect, no floor.

sofa.action: One cozy burnt-orange two-seat sofa with wood feet, pale cream square throw pillow touching left cushion. Viewed from above and front. About 56x30 logical pixels, no person or floor.

tv.action: One identical compact charcoal television on low wooden media cabinet, about 48x40 logical pixels. All 3 screens show a clear cream triangular PLAY icon on muted red rectangle. Frame 0 navy screen, frame 1 teal screen with two small progress bar pixels, frame 2 navy screen with shifted progress bar. Only screen pixels change. No brand words, no people or floor.

plants.action: Three STATIC plants: frame 0 leafy broad-leaf houseplant in terracotta pot about 24x32 pixels; frame 1 tall narrow fern in cream pot about 22x40; frame 2 tiny succulent in ochre pot about 20x24. Dense connected leaves, all leaves touch stems and pot. No floating bits or floor.

window.action: One wall-mounted warm wooden window frame with 4 pale blue panes, cream curtain folded at each side touching frame, tiny distant blocky skyline. Front-facing wall prop about 48x36 logical pixels. No wall or floor around it.

door.action: Two identical wooden office doorway frames about 32x48 logical pixels. Frame 0 door closed with little brass knob. Frame 1 door OPEN inward with dark teal doorway and brown door panel partly to side, frame silhouette connected. No surrounding wall or floor.

clock.action: Three simple ivory round wall clocks with warm charcoal outlines, same about 22x22 logical pixel size, no numbers. Hands show respectively 9 oclock, 12 oclock, 3 oclock. Red second hand optional one chunky line. No wall, floor or detached ticks.
